programmes.d: Logan calls in an air strike on a Lycanthrope weapons dump before he realizes it is also a werewolf hospital...

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mermaid Magic
programmes.d: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Power Play
programmes.d: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the café. Cleo's caught in the crossfire with Kim when Samantha moves in and puts her stamp on the Sertori home.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Dark Side
programmes.d: Rikki's frustrated by the water attacks and goes to Mako Island on a full moon to confront the strange force in the Moon Pool. With Cleo and Bella delayed, Will pursues her and discovers she's been affected by the experience.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Magnetic Attraction
programmes.d: Cleo's introduced to Ryan, a young geophysicist who's working for Samantha. Rikki doesn't react well to Cleo consulting Ryan about the Mako rock and a fracture begins to appear in the trio.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Into the Light
programmes.d: Rikki fears Ryan's explorations on Mako Island will uncover their secrets but Cleo and Bella discount her concern. She almost goes too far trying to stop Ryan from discovering the crystals in the Moon Pool.

Will competes in the Free-Diving Championships but afterward chooses to break from the sport and shrug off Sophie's influence on his life. Rikki sees Sophie kissing Zane at the event and breaks off their relationship.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Queen for a Day
programmes.d: Zane installs Sophie as head of staff at the café. Bella develops a sneezing allergy that also accidentally triggers her powers. Sophie seizes on the problem and looks to fire Bella and the band.
While on a beach vacation, Zyro and the others solve a mystery about a supposed Sea Monster.
Zyro and his friends are sent by the WBBA to show bladers around the world how much fun beyblading in the new Cyclone Beystadium can be.
Shinobu Hiryuin and his Ninja Salamander are defeated by Sakyo Kurayami and his Ronin Dragoon.
A Blader named Yoshio Iwayama comes to town and defeats both Eight and Kite Unabara.
Ren and Shinobu train with Zyro. Takanosuke defeats Kikura, but he then loses to Kite Unabara.
Yoshio defeats Akuya and his followers, but then loses to Zyro. Kira appears and battles and defeats Shinobu.
It’s Witch vs. Witch in the annual spell-a-thon, and Sabrina is determined she is going to cast the biggest and best spell of all.

Hilda and Zelda are going to the Netherworld for some much needed Rest & Relaxation (it’s the witch equivalent of going to Las Vegas). Although Sabrina does everything her power to dissuade them, they insist on hiring a babysitter.
Sabrina’s cauldron blows up and splatters Cassandra with purplescent slime.
Sabrina is obsessing over the whole romantic triangle thing with Harvey and Cassandra.
Sabrina’s move to high school with its more demanding physical education classes has forced her to dash from the showers to her next class with her hair a disaster.
Riverdale's citizens are scared into a state of shock, being found clutching overdue library book notices.
Archie and Jughead get locked in the Riverdale museum with a mummy inexplicably determined to get revenge against our boy hero.
When practical joker Reggie scares Archie with a Wolfman mask, his prank backfires!
Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.
Cleo is failing at school and is assigned a tutor - Charlotte. Cleo wants Lewis back but her attitude to Charlotte only drives him further away. Cleo discovers Lewis and Charlotte kissing.
Zane hears of a treasure under the ocean and enlists the girls to find it. Rikki is injured in the search. Zane gives Rikki the reward. Charlotte contrives to keep Lewis from the girls.
Emma starts acting weird after pricking her finger on a barb of coral. Cleo’s fish Hector exhibits the same behaviour. Emma becomes more and more like a fish and Lewis has to find a way to cure her.

Don takes the family camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. The girls are affected and need the moon pool for sanctuary. Charlotte almost slips in the moon pool and realises something weird is going on there.
After finding a TV script in his mailbox, Marshall finds himself in Hollywood, his family out of character and his name 'Omri' - who's destined to die in the script.
Marshall must save his family from the clutches of a body snatchers--like cult of kitchenware fanatics who preserve their children by sealing them into human sized tupperware.
Wendell has had his share of bullying from pranksters Chet and Louie.
When neighbourhood Ghost, Goblin and Troll Expert "Sheldon" tells his best buddy Eddie that there's a Troll under the bridge and it's following him home.

Unbeknownst to the boys, Cassy's been doing volunteer work before and after class, helping Dr. Mender, the resident bestial physician, tend to injured enchanted creatures. Cassy discovers she has a real gift for healing.
Class clown, Gus, is big on getting laughs. Cassy thinks she's just as funny and a competition begins.

The Howards have been selected to be the All-American Family. However, with the press and media watching their every move, the family is concerned their secret will revealed. The family try to make a conscious effort to act as "normal" as possible.
A new family has moved to Wolverton, and they use their mysterious powers to turn the townspeople into zombies. The only people able to withstand their powers are the Howards.
Scott, Stiles, and Boof head downtown to celebrate Scott's winning touchdown, and Grandma gives him a special potion that will keep him from turning into a werewolf for the night.

In an adjacent town, Scott picks up a flamingo sink for his dad's customer. While leaving the shop, he falls down a manhole and loses his memory. Scott explores all over the town in order to remember his identity, and his family goes searching for him.
After Scott and his rock band perform a song on a televised talent show, Scott is discovered by a record label that wants to sign him.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: I was a Teenage Vampire
programmes.d: The Vampires are back, and this time Scarlet has unearthed her evil master Medlock, the Lord of the Vampires.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Halloween of Horror
programmes.d: Veronica's annual Halloween bash turns into chaos when the resurrected Lord of the Vampires crashes the party.

Pink, Pink and Away': Super Pink flies into action when the Dogfather robs a bank and then accidentally kidnaps a little boy. 'Down on the Ant Farm': The Panther's experimental ant farm, complete with Ant, is accidentally delivered to the Aardvark.

Pinky in Paradise': Aided by a Parrot, Pinky searches for buried treasure only to come up against a Voodoo Man. 'Department Story Pink-erton': Pinky gets a security job at a department store and must contend with the notorious 'Whistler.'
Sonic and Tails infiltrate Robotnik's new Casino Night Zone to stop him and his henchmen from scamming a group of sheep into becoming Robotnik's slaves.

Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist for making fun of him in his comic book where he couldn't get up after falling. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell.
Inspector Gadget foils Dr. Claw's plans to destroy him while on a vacation at a health spa.
Inspector Gadget's undercover assignment takes place on a luxury liner where the wealthiest people in the world are on holiday. His mission is to prevent Dr. Claw from stealing their jewels.
It's Nightmare on Bean Street! Who's afraid of daft films about giant killer cats, blobs from outer space and thumb-size men who dance around in sugar bowls?
Romance is in the air and Bean's girlfriend is determined to have a piece of it.

An escaped prisoner suffers hard labour under Mrs. Wicket while Mr. Bean puts his feet up in jail. Mistaken for an escaped convict, Bean is carted off to jail where he finds that, with a little imagination, prison can be quite nice actually.

High-tech wizardry and low-tech cunning get Mr. Bean out of a jam. Mr. Bean finds himself dogged by a young Japanese boy at the Science Museum. He takes an instant dislike to the Scallywag until he sees what the kid has in his backpack.

Mr. Bean learns that generosity can be an effective weapon against greed, gluttony and getting your hands back on your own TV remote control. Mr. Bean cannot, for the life of him, place the face of the uninvited fat bloke on his doorstep.
When Rip's old college professor, Dr. Sullivan, searching the Amazon for a million-year-old dinosaur egg, falls ill, the BION team rush to South America.
